title: Review Queue
markdown:
**What it is:** A quality-control queue for incoming knowledge, facts, and information *before* the Executive starts relying on it.

**What it does:**

- List items awaiting review with their status (pending, approved, rejected, needs revision) and priority.
- Open any item to see its full content and where it came from.
- Approve, reject, or flag an item for revision — and attach corrections without changing the original.
- Bulk-approve everything pending, or a whole domain at once when you trust the source.

**How to use:**

1. Open **Knowledge** in the sidebar, pick the **Advanced** tab, then **Review queue** (`/knowledge?view=review` opens it directly). The number on **Advanced** and on **Knowledge** in the sidebar shows how many items are waiting.
2. On **To review**, choose **View details** in an item's **⋯** menu to read it and see where it came from.
3. Decide:
   - **Approve** — the button on the item: the Executive can use it.
   - **Flag for revision** (in **⋯**) — mark it *needs revision* as a reminder to follow up. A flagged item stays in use until you reject it.
   - **Reject…** (in **⋯**) — keep it out; you can add a note saying why.
   - **Priority** (in **⋯**: ↑ High / Normal / ↓ Low) orders your queue.
4. To fix a detail instead of rejecting the whole item, open **View details**, type in *Add a correction or clarification…* and click **Add**. Active corrections are given to the Executive alongside the item; toggle one to **Inactive** to retire it.
5. Trust a source? Click **Approve all pending**, or on **All items** pick a domain and click **Approve all pending in *domain***.

**Where items come from:** playbook and failure-case files you add or edit under **Built-in playbooks** on the Knowledge page, and any domain you choose to **Curate** — curating holds that domain's built-in knowledge back from the Executive until you approve it (**Stop curating** releases it). Company documents you upload go straight to **Company documents** and don't appear here.

**Example:** you add a *discount-policy* playbook under finance. It shows up here as pending; open it, add the correction *"Discounts over 15% need CFO sign-off"*, then **Approve** — the Executive now uses the playbook with your correction attached.

*Tip: when you open a playbook or failure case under **Built-in playbooks**, its review status shows under the filename, with **Approve** right there and **Flag for revision** in its **⋯** menu.*

*Note: approved and flagged items feed retrieval; pending and rejected ones are kept out. Editing an approved playbook flags it for re-review without taking it out of use.*
